user.title: Unity hub
user.description: Settings shared by every child instance. Add each child afterwards with “Add child instance”. Children only ever see entities that carry their label on one of their floors, or the common label on a common floor.

data_description.common_label: Entities with this label are shown to every child, if they are in an area on a common floor.
data_description.common_floors: Floors the common label is valid on. The label and a floor are both required.
data_description.hub_status_topic: Retained topic that reads “online” while this hub is up. Set your MQTT will message to “offline” on the same topic.
data_description.area_prefix_regex: Optional regex for a prefix on hub area names that must not reach a child. For example `^L[0-9]+ ` turns “L2 Kitchen” into “Kitchen”. A trailing space is optional; leftover spaces are trimmed.
data_description.blocked_cover_classes: Covers of these device classes are never shown to a child.

error.invalid_topic: Use a concrete topic without wildcards or empty levels.
error.invalid_regex: That is not a valid regular expression.
error.common_pair: Set both the common label and the common floors, or neither.

user.title: Add child instance
user.description: A child sees only entities with its label that are in an area on one of its floors.

data_description.unit: Lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_”. It becomes the first level of every MQTT topic for this child, so it must match what the broker allows that child to use.
data_description.unit_label: Entities with this label are shown to this child.
data_description.unit_floors: The label only counts on these floors.

error.invalid_unit: Use lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_” (no slashes or wildcards).
error.duplicate_unit: A child with this name already exists.

user.title: Add thermostat
user.description: Give a child a thermostat for one room. The guest can only change the target temperature, within the range you set.

data_description.unit: The child that gets this thermostat.
data_description.climate_entity: The hub climate entity guests effectively set. For RoomMind choose the **room** entity (`climate.roommind_<room>`), not the deprecated `_override` one. It must carry the child's label (or the common label) and be in an area on that child's floor, like any other entity.
data_description.object: Optional. Lowercase letters, digits and `_`; part of the MQTT topics. Defaults to the entity's name.
data_description.min_temp: In the hub's temperature unit. The guest can never set below this.
data_description.max_temp: In the hub's temperature unit. The guest can never set above this.
data_description.current_sensor: Leave empty to use the climate entity's own current temperature.
data_description.target_sensor: Leave empty to use the climate entity's own target temperature.
data_description.expire_after_minutes: 0 keeps a guest setpoint until your controller changes it.
data_description.expire_mode: What the hub does when the time is up. “End the override” selects the `none` preset, which returns RoomMind and similar controllers to their schedule.

error.duplicate_thermostat: That child already has a thermostat with this room name.

error.range_outside_entity: This range is outside what the climate entity accepts.
error.expire_needs_mode: Choose what should happen when the time is up, or set the time to 0.
